regions.label: Remi app
lines: AM I ON TRACK TO MOVE CLEANLY?

Every Private Credit exit lands before 4 Jan, with 8 business days to spare. The one to watch is the returns pipeline: forecast Wed 2 Dec, 1 business day before the December run your successor needs to shadow.
One block per remaining business day; bank holidays left out.
Successor shadows the Thu 3 Dec run on the automated pipeline
Successor builds the Thu 10 Dec pack; commentary stays manual
Forecast ready Mon 4 Jan, the day of the move. The dry run on Thu 17 Dec is the real test.
In Define, charter half-written. Planning starts once the rotation is under way.
Say what happened in your own words. Remi works out what to change and shows you before anything moves.
Write it the way you would tell a colleague.
“I can give ManCo 2h a day now.”
You review every change before it's applied. Nothing is lost if Remi gets it wrong.
Nothing changes until you review and apply.
